questions.prompt: Cosines 0.95 (A) and 0.93 (B), tau = 0.01. What is P(A)? Give 3 decimals.
Cosine similarities of an image with two class prompts are 0.95 (class A) and 0.93 (class B), with unit-length embeddings and tau = 1. What is P(A)? Give 3 decimals.
A prompt ensemble for one class is built by
options: averaging the probabilities that were predicted for different images
taking the single longest prompt and using its text embedding
summing the image embeddings of all the classes and normalising
averaging unit-normalised text embeddings and re-normalising the mean
questions.explanation: This reduces the variance from any single template.

questions.prompt: A student chooses the best of 20 prompt templates by accuracy on the test set and reports that accuracy. What is the problem?
options: No problem if the test set is large, since the selection effect then vanishes.
The reported accuracy is optimistically biased as the test set was used for selection.
The prompts are too short, so the accuracy cannot be compared fairly.
Prompt selection is impossible, since the labels are not known in advance.
questions.explanation: Selecting the maximum of 20 noisy estimates on the same data overstates performance.

questions.prompt: A test set with 3 classes has per-class recalls 0.9, 0.8 and 0.1. What is the macro accuracy (2 decimals)?
Wilson interval for 8 of 10 correct: what is its lower bound (3 decimals)?
Test-set size for half-width 0.03 at p = 0.8 (normal approximation, round up).
Which result gives the strongest evidence that a model beats a majority-class baseline of 0.9?
questions.explanation: Only the large set has an interval that can exclude 0.9: roughly [0.91, 0.93].

questions.prompt: A segmentation prompt of one point on a mug handle returns only the handle. What is the most accurate description?
options: The prompt is ambiguous: a point lies in several nested objects, so add prompts.
The model failed, because a mug handle is not a valid segmentation target.
SAM cannot segment mugs, since they are not in its training categories.
The temperature is too high, which makes the mask collapse to one part.
questions.explanation: A single point can mean handle, mug or table; promptable models return one of several valid masks.
